description: Rothco ‘s Street Shield Cut Resistant Police Gloves offer superior protection and durability, making them the ideal choice for law enforcement and tactical professionals. Designed with a cut-resistant lining inside the fingers, these duty gloves safeguard your hands from potential injuries while on duty. The uniform gloves are made from synthetic leather, providing a robust and resilient exterior, while the non-skid grip material enhances your control during critical situations. The neoprene and nylon spandex backing ensure a snug and comfortable fit, allowing for maximum dexterity and precision. Additionally, the terry cloth on the outer thumb provides a convenient way to wipe away sweat, keeping your hands dry and ready for action. The hook & loop closure system allows you to adjust the tactical gloves for a secure and custom fit, ensuring they stay in place during intense activities. Rothco’s Street Shield Cut Resistant Police Gloves are the ultimate combination of protection, comfort, and functionality for those who demand the best in their line of work.
